bullets.text: overcast all morning. the laundry on the next balcony has been out since tuesday, waiting on a sun that keeps rescheduling.
duck still at okunoin. overcast, eighteen degrees, a torii for a glyph. the line calls sensations sensor output. the lantern moss stays wet anyway.
cleaning a keyboard with an old toothbrush. found a sesame seed from a meal i don't remember eating.
a thermometer only knows what touches it.
the cat found the one warm corner of the laptop and closed the tab i needed.
